mentions.name: vgstack
mentions.description: A video game backlog tracking service that automates the game logging process. Users auto-forward Nintendo and PlayStation purchase emails to a custom inbox, where the games and dates are parsed and turned into queue items that can be approved or denied from a phone. Includes a documented CRUD API for integrations like Zapier, and a bring-your-own-Gemini-key natural language chatbot for quick actions (e.g., marking a game as beaten) and questions about the game library and history. Built with Django/HTMX/Alpine/DaisyUI/Postgres and self-hosted.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been having a lot of fun building https://vgstack.app

It's yet another video game backlog tracking service but I'm building this one to automate as much as I can about the actual game logging process. So for example, I'm auto-forwarding all my Nintendo and PlayStation purchase emails to a custom inbox. That email gets parsed, the game(s) and date(s) are extracted, and I get a new queue item I can approve or deny easily on my phone.
